LE 01360648

Aspidistra longifolia Hook.f.⁣ ⟮prelim. ID⟯ det. Averyanov, Leonid Vladimirovich at 14.10.2026

Field collecting number: AL2682. Collection date: 14.10.2026.
Administrative regions: VN - Tinh Lam GJong.
Groups of specimens: L. V. Averyanov specimens; L. V. Averyanov photos; Flora of Vietnam
Original label text:
FLORA OF VIETNAM
Convallariaceae
Aspidistra longifolia Hook.f.

Lam Dong Province, Di Linh District, Brah Yang Mountain, primary and old secondary evergreen broad-leaved and mixed forest (with Pinus khasya) on granite around point 11º27.669ʹ N 108º03.543ʹ E at elevation of 1100-1200 m a.s.l. Terrestrial rhizomatous herb on shady rocky slope. Locally very common. 13 November 2023, L. Averyanov, Nguyen Van Canh, T. Maisak, AL2682 (living plant only).

Flowered in culture 28 October 2025, L. Averyanov, T. Maisak, AL2682.

Groups of specimens: L. V. Averyanov specimens; L. V. Averyanov photos; Flora of Vietnam
Original label text:
FLORA OF VIETNAM
Convallariaceae
Ophiopogon ogisui Minoru N.Tamura et J.M.Xu

Northern Vietnam, limestone area allied to Chinese border. Terrestrial herb in primary and secondary evergreen broad-leaved shady lowland forests on limestone at elevations about 400-500 m a.s.l., rare. Cultivated in Hanoi. Coll.: Nguyen Minh Duc, L.Averyanov, sine n., 8 November 2014 (LE).

Flowered in culture on 14 October 2026, L. Averyanov, sine num., Garden Number 23173.
